en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Gothic‑style exterior staircase attached to a historic building. The staircase leads up through arched openings supported by slender columns, with richly carved stonework, tracery, and a large decorative crest above the arch. Adjacent façades have tall mullioned windows and carved details. Text at the bottom identifies the view as the staircase of the library in Bruges.
